title_sq: SHITET VILE 2-KATESHE NE SAUK TE RI

title_en: 2-STOREY VILLA FOR SALE IN SAUK NEW
description_en: In the area of ​​Sauk te Ri, a 2-storey villa with potential for residential or business activities is offered for sale. The property is located in a privileged position, offering 360° views towards Farka, Sauk and Mjullbathora. Main features: Area for each floor: 160 m² of which 40 m² balconies/verandahs Dedicated garage: Garage on floor 0 with capacity for 2 cars Organization of premises: FLOOR 1 • Spacious living room • 3 bedrooms • 2 bathrooms • Balconies with open view FLOOR 2 • Living room • 2 large rooms with balconies • 1 bathroom Benefits & Potential • Internal space allows for reorganization flexible, according to the desire and the new project • The villa requires restoration, but offers an excellent basis for customization • Suitable for both family living and professional activities: clinics, wellness centers, office buildings, educational facilities, etc. - For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
